sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops the chain when any link is nil — the whole expression dissolves into nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any one person in between is gone, the whole reaching silently fails to arrive.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with a single method that is never implemented — a contract that exists but is never fulfilled
sketches.resonance: A promise defined so precisely that no one can live up to it; the interface compiles, but the method body never exists.

sketches.mechanism: A pointer is dereferenced after being freed — the memory was real, but accessing it is undefined behavior
sketches.resonance: You kept the address of something already gone; the language cannot tell you what you'll find there now.
